claim: Phase 7 evaluates all 165 Phase 6 high-priority internal candidates without importing new observations.
The hand-off contains 12 abundance replication anchors and 8 detection-mechanism sentinels selected by frozen branch-specific rules.
Pareto fronts preserve trade-offs among effect, multiplicity evidence, robustness and cross-domain support without a post-hoc weighted score.
Correlation components reduce redundant abundance follow-up choices but do not prove shared mechanisms.
Sample-size tables are sensitivity grids over assumed effects, not power guarantees based on selected discovery estimates.
No independent, orthogonal or clinical validation was executed in Phase 7.
